purpose: Teach: 士郎/一太郎/大竹/せりふ/ぶた/オトコ/メンズ/いっか

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「衛宮士郎は正義感のあるキャラ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me how Emiya Shiro is such a character with a strong sense of justice.
lines.style: Warm, sharing-a-moment tone. Speaking to Sho as if including him in something gentle her husband said. No rush. Slight lift at the end—she's inviting him to hear about Dad.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとワープロソフト「一太郎」で文書を作ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I made a document together using Ichitaro word processor software.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Speaking matter-of-factly about the work, not bragging. Small, genuine satisfaction. Natural child rhythm—he's just telling her what happened.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ものまね芸人の大竹さんは上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how that impressionist Otake is really talented at what he does.
lines.style: Observant, passing along something she noticed in the conversation. Gentle delivery. She's reflecting on her husband's comment more than performing it. Warm but grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと舞台のせりふを練習したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I practiced stage lines together today.
lines.style: Direct, simple report. A small glow of contentment underneath. He's not showing off—just stating the fact of something that happened between them.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ぶたさんの可愛い絵本を読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying we should read a really cute picture book about a little pig together.
lines.style: Tender invitation in her tone. She's quoting her husband but softly—not pushing, suggesting. Slight warmth on the word 'cute.' She's painting a picture of something gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「強いオトコになりなさい」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me I should become a strong man.
lines.style: Solemn, taking the words seriously. He's holding his father's instruction carefully in his voice. Quiet certainty—he heard something that matters. No performance, just the weight of it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとメンズの靴を一緒に買いに行ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad and I went shopping for men's shoes together today.
lines.style: Gentle noting of a small, shared moment. She's reflecting on the outing—not making a big thing of it, but there's quiet contentment in the remembering. Straightforward, warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「もう寝るの?いっか、お休み」って優しく仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad asked if I was already going to bed, and then he said so gently, 'Well, alright then. Sleep well.'
lines.style: Tender recollection of his father's kindness. He's remembering the gentleness in the voice, not just the words. Quiet and trusting. A moment of being cared for, simply expressed.
